content.text: The licence grant fully meets our preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 13.3 Customer may transfer its licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24. Vendor shall not revoke or suspend a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
input.rationale: Section 13 already satisfies the preferred position on every parameter. Clause 13.1 grants the subscription access right to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf" (with Authorized Users permitted), so affiliates and contractors are expressly in scope. Clause 13.2 gives Customer and its Affiliates a "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence" for paid-up software and Vendor Technology, including the right to permit contractors to support that material; Section 14.3 confirms that perpetual licence extends to Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables. Clause 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under the Section 24 assignment right (which allows assignment to an M&A successor without Vendor consent) and limits revocation/suspension to a material uncured breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity — i.e., no revocability at Vendor's will. No unilateral suspension rights appear elsewhere (Section 24.4 bars suspension on Customer change of control). No edit required.
